text:
sara: Heads-up — OpenSSL CVE-2026-0001 affects our onprem images (libssl 1.1.1 family). Need triage + backport plan for Dedicated/Private customers. Can we sketch the path for customer branches, image signing, and KMS implications? :rotating_light:

tom: Can you drop the CVE link and list of affected images? I'll check which dedicated pools are on those tags.

sara: Link: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-0001
Affected images we ship:
```
redwood/onprem:1.4.2
redwood/onprem:1.3.9
redwood/private-runtime:2024-11-07
```
Also some customers use pinned customer-image branches (cust-ACME/sha256:...). This CVE requires a patch to the vendor lib and a minor rebuild (no schema changes).

li: Quick notes from triage: upstream backport is to 1.1.1q with a small API-preserving patch. No runtime ABI bump expected, but the distro packaging changes glibc deps for older kernels. For onprem we need to: 1) build the patched lib into our images, 2) run smoke + perf, 3) sign artifacts.

maya: Prioritization: any Dedicated pool serving external traffic or customers with regulatory needs = P0/P1. Others P2. Also flag customers with HSM/KMS setups — the image swap must not break KMS plugin versions.

ops-eng: For VPC/airgapped installs we can't push image automatically. We'll produce signed tarballs + a per-customer manifest and handoff docs. Ops will need a branch per customer if they require custom patches. Example commands I'll provide: 
```
# build and tag
git checkout -b security/CVE-2026-0001 1.4.x
# bump openssl vendor commit
make image && docker tag redwood/onprem:staging redwood/onprem:1.4.3-cve2026
```

deploy-bot: Created ticket SEC-4321: "CVE-2026-0001 backport + onprem image releases" and assigned to @sara, @ops-eng.

ci-bot: CI: security/CVE-2026-0001 build succeeded (linux-amd64, smoke-tests) — 12m elapsed.

security-oncall: I'll draft the customer advisory and an audit-log entry. Important: record the RBAC changes (if any) needed for image deploy helpers, and note KMS key-rotation steps in the advisory. Also include a quick checklist for SOC: 
- CVE summary + CVSS
- Affected images + customer fingerprint method
- Mitigation steps (image replace, tarball install)
- Verification commands (sha256, smoke checks)

sara: Proposed rollout plan: 
1) Merge PR into 1.4.x and create 1.4.3-cve2026 image (canary in hosted infra).
2) Run canary smoke+latency tests (24h).
3) Produce signed tarballs and CV-signed manifests for onprem customers.
4) For customers with custom branches, open per-customer PRs (ops-eng to coordinate).
5) Push advisory + schedule human-assisted installs for airgapped sites.

li: One more: KMS integration caveat — some Private installs use legacy KMS plugin that expects openssl 1.0 APIs. Confirm all KMS clients on private installs are compatible or schedule a parallel plugin update.

ops-eng: I'll inventory KMS plugin versions across pinned customers and report by EOD. If incompatible, we'll include a migration note in the advisory.

maya: Add rollback instructions in the runbook: how to revert to previous image and how to rebind KMS keys if needed. Also ensure audit-logging catches the image swap event: service/deployer identity + timestamp + SHA.

sara: Action items (assigning):
- @sara open PR + image build (ETA 12h).
- @ops-eng inventory KMS plugin versions + per-customer branch plan (ETA 24h).
- @li confirm patch is binary-compatible and prepare smoke test matrix (ETA 12h).
- @security-oncall draft advisory + audit entries (ETA 24h).

maya: acked. I'll set priority for customers with public endpoints and request SOC review.

tom: thumbs up. Let me know if you need us to schedule Dedicated pool maintenance windows.

sara: Thanks — creating PR now and will post link when ready. :thumbsup:
